description: This file contains classes, functions, and logic related to managing TLS configurations and probing for TLS fingerprints in a Kotlin-based Android application. It includes data structures for TLS parameters and configurations, methods to build TLS configs, and a coroutine-based function to probe the TLS fingerprint of a gateway.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Data class representing parameters required for TLS configuration, including fingerprint expectations and trust options.

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for TLS connections.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum indicating possible failure modes when probing TLS, such as unavailability or unreachable endpoint.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a TLS fingerprint probe, including the fingerprint hash and failure reason if any.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Constructs a GatewayTlsConfig object based on provided parameters and optional fingerprint storage callback.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Asynchronously probes the TLS fingerprint of a specified host and port, returning the result with fingerprint hash or failure status.
